name: DeR^2
intro: DeR2是一个受控的深度研究沙盒，旨在隔离文档基础推理，同时保留深度搜索的核心难点，如多步合成、去噪和基于证据的结论制定。它通过四种机制将证据访问与推理解耦，从而量化检索损失和推理损失，并实现细粒度的错误归因。为防止参数泄露，DeR2采用两阶段验证，确保在没有证据的情况下参数失败，同时保证预言概念的可解性。每个实例都提供了一个冻结的文档库，其中包含专家标注的概念和验证的理由。
build_method: 专家构建, 人工标注, 模型难度校准
metric: 答案级准确率；知识损失、检索损失、噪声诱发损失、文档到概念损失；RLoss = 仅概念 − 完整文档集
eval_feature: 防污染, 冻结文档库, 受控条件对照, 过程评估
scale: 300个问题；论文称平均6.5篇文档；固定TSV为1,777/300=5.9233
build_method_en: Expert curation, human annotation, model difficulty calibration
eval_feature_en: Contamination-free, frozen document libraries, controlled-regime comparison, process evaluation
intro_en: DeR2 is a controlled deep research sandbox designed to isolate document-based reasoning while retaining core challenges of deep search, such as multi-step synthesis, denoising, and evidence-based conclusion formulation. It decouples evidence access from reasoning through four mechanisms, enabling quantification of retrieval loss and reasoning loss, as well as fine-grained error attribution. To prevent parameter leakage, DeR2 employs two-stage validation to ensure parameter failure without evidence while guaranteeing the solvability of predicted concepts. Each instance provides a frozen document corpus containing expert-annotated concepts and verified rationales.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2601.21937v2 Sections 2.3 and 3 plus Appendix A, official repository revision 95a8aba9b4a5091e30c9d93bf79bb3d5fadb70c6, and Hugging Face dataset revision b0a84aed28d9a18bc6669dbf41d7ffcb91f4e01f; DeR2-300.tsv SHA256 is 3473fab60fd1509c99e93c40c5612a03de527f722d7bc4e5c02cc559ad7d05c4. Count boundary: the paper reports mean 6.5 documents, while the pinned TSV totals 1,111 related plus 666 noise document references, or 1,777 over 300 rows and 5.9233 per item. Appendix A defines three distinct prompt templates: Related-only and Full-set share one template, Concepts-only uses a second, and Instruction-only a third; only the evaluation procedure and scoring are shared. The diagram records 81 PhD annotators, five human-finalized fields, three-run calibration, frozen related/noise documents, and no train/dev/test split. Inference uses deterministic 30,000-character head-tail truncation, no web, temperature=1 and top_p=0.7, and runs each model-setting twice before averaging. The paper names Knowledge Loss, Retrieval Loss, Noise-induced Loss, and Document-to-concept Loss without adding KLoss, D2C, or NLoss abbreviations; the only formal loss formula retained is RLoss = Concepts-only − Full-set.
